title: Restore a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: Learn how to restore a company or partnership contractor licence if it has expired.
intro:
If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and you have not renewed it before the licence expiry date you need to visit a Service NSW Centre to restore the licence.

You must restore your licence within 3 months of the expiry date, or you have to apply for a new company or partnership contractor licence.

You cannot trade as a contractor if your licence is not current.

To check your registration number and details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Hold a company or partnership contractor licence that has expired.
Must restore the licence within 3 months of the expiry date.
what_you_need: Proof of identity (if you do not have your renewal notice)
Take your renewal notice and payment to a service centre

faqs.q: What must I do if my company or partnership contractor licence has expired?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to restore the licence. You have 3 months from the expiry date to restore it, otherwise, you must apply for a new licence.

faqs.q: Can I work as a contractor if my licence is not current?
faqs.a: No, you cannot trade as a contractor if your licence is not current.

faqs.q: How can I check my registration number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your registration number and details by visiting Verify NSW.
